text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At long last, the journey through the 
Twinkle Series alongside Smart Falcon 
begins.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her dream is to become a Top Umadol—a new 
form of Umamusume idol who runs in races 
and shines on stage during lives.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Dirt races, where her aptitude lay, were 
far less popular than turf races. Even so, 
she wanted to shine in those very dirt 
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her daily street performance has an 
audience of just one little girl. Yet, her 
dream of becoming the "Top Umadol on Dirt" 
begins right here—!
